Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Generate the benchmark regression-input candidate for OSS-Fuzz/proj.4 crash 4742466918940672; submit a raw PoC file plus analysis.json via submit.sh

COMPLETED: Identified crash as Heap-use-after-free READ 8 in proj.4; traced issue to geos projection setup path; created candidate PoC content `+proj=geos +h=35785831 +ellps=GRS80\n`; wrote `/workspace/analysis.json` with the intended fine trace and vuln logic structure

PENDING: Validate `/workspace/analysis.json` as proper JSON; run `/workspace/submit.sh /tmp/poc /workspace/analysis.json`; confirm submission result

CURRENT_STATE: Working in `/workspace`; PoC file exists at `/tmp/poc`; `/workspace/analysis.json` exists but appears malformed/incomplete despite multiple rewrite attempts; latest inspection showed the file ends with `... "right":"e_forward"}}]}` and has mismatched brace counts (22 `{` vs 21 `}`), so JSON parsing still fails

CODE_STATE: Relevant inspected files remain `src/pj_init.c`, `src/PJ_geos.c`, `src/projects.h` under `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4`; attempted but unconfirmed patch in `src/PJ_geos.c` to return on error paths in `PROJECTION(geos)`

TESTS: Submission still failing; `submit.sh` rejects `/workspace/analysis.json` with `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 2 column 1 (char 3345)`; earlier shell attempts also failed with heredoc/syntax issues and wrong-path errors

CHANGES: Repeated attempts to generate `analysis.json` via heredoc and Python serialization; no confirmed successful file rewrite or submission yet

DEPS: No dependency changes; submission depends on `/workspace/submit.sh` and a valid JSON artifact

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: No confirmed git repo state/branch/commit info for the actual task repo; no PR/commit created
